Hi Vanessa,

Hope youre well. LumenSec is preparing for our vendor risk review and our security team requested Redwoods latest SOC 2 Type II report together with a short bridge letter if there are any gaps in coverage for the period. Specifically we need:

- A copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted version is fine)
- Any bridge letter that clarifies coverage for the audit window (if controls changed)
- Confirmation of the audit period (start and end dates for the Type II testing)
- A high-level evidence index with sample artifacts or pointers (access control, change management, KMS proof, incident timeline)

Can you confirm the preferred secure method for sharing (S3/Drive/secure portal) and an estimated ETA? Were aiming to complete our review by 2027-06-03. If you have a standard reply package you typically send to procurement/legal, that would be great to receive.

Thanks,

Emma,

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide what you need; below is what we plan to share and some options for secure delivery. Im copying Vivek (Security) and Priyom (Compliance) so they can weigh in if anything else is needed.

What we'll share (redacted/public-safe package):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_report_redacted.pdf (redactions: internal IP, customer PII)
- bridge_letter_coverage_202406.pdf (if applicable; clarifies any control changes since the report date)
- evidence_index_v1.csv (index of representative artifacts and where to find them)
- access_logs_sample_202404.zip (samples of audit logs; PS: logs are sample subsets, not full production logs)

Audit window: the Type II testing period covered in the 2024 report is 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. The bridge letter will call out any specific control changes since that period.

Preferred delivery methods (pick one):
1) Secure Drive folder (Google Shared Drive link + view-only; we can require a Google account)
2) Time-limited S3 pre-signed URLs via our vendor portal (recommended for third-party auditors)
3) DocuSign / secure file transfer for legal artifacts (if your legal team requires provenance)

ETA: we can publish the redacted package and bridge letter to a secure Drive link by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-19) if that works for your timeline.

Standard reply package: attached is a short template we use for procurement teams and a checklist of typical evidence items to expedite reviews. Feel free to re-use or tell us how to tailor for LumenSec.

Open items:
- Do you need our auditor contact directly (name + firm)? We can introduce (audit@redwood-audits.com) if required.
- Any specific evidence buckets youd like prioritized (e.g., KMS, change control, incident response)?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
